The row is therefore the thesis itself, whose chapter 3 the user confirms was a manuscript in preparation. The two are also not demonstrably the same work - different titles, eleven authors against seventeen, and Crossref declares no relation between the thesis DOI and either version - so per the 2026-11-02 rule the thesis is classified on its own merits. Note the row was queued as indexed nowhere, yet Crossref does index it as a dissertation; the automated look-up queries PubMed and OpenAlex only, and Scholar's own byline carried affiliation superscripts inside the names (Hendriks$^1$, Cod{\'e}e) which is why the stored list was unusable.
